nanoSeconds.description: The nanoseconds part of the time. Time is defined as Unix-time since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC.

seconds.description: The seconds part of the time. Time is defined as Unixtime since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC.

customerPremisesInfo.description: The physical location of a customer site.

latitude.description: Latitude (DATUM=WGS84) -90 to 90 in decimal degree format DDD.ddd

longitude.description: Longitude (DATUM=WGS84) -180 to 180 in decimal degree format DDD.ddd

ponSYS_ID.description: The 20-bit identity of the optical system within a certain domain.This is a reference value set by the OSS.

onuId.description: Information to identify an Optical Network Unit.

ponTech.description: An informative field identifying the optical technology used. The valid values are: 1 = GPON. 2 = XGPON.3 = NGPON2. 4 = XGSPON.

operationalState.description: It reports whether the ONU is currently capable of performing its function. Valid values are: 0 = enabled 1 = disabled

dsRate.description:
Downstream line rate, valid values are:
1 =	2,48832 Gbit/s: G-PON [i.9]; or
NG-PON2 option 2 [i.8].
2 =	9,95328 Gbit/s:  XG-PON [i.10]; or
 XGS-PON [i.11]; or
NG-PON2 option 1 [i.8].

usRate.description:
Upstream line rate, valid values are:
1 =	1,24416 Gbit/s: G-PON option 1 [i.9].
2 =	2,48832 Gbit/s: G-PON option 2 [i.9]; or
XG-PON [i.10]; or
NG-PON2 option 2 [i.8].
3 =	9,95328 Gbit/s: XGS-PON [i.11]; or
NG-PON2 option 1 [i.8].
